title: Jupiter Swap - SOL to Token
natural_language_templates: Swap {amount} SOL for {token_address} tokens on Jupiter
Exchange {amount} SOL to {token_address} using Jupiter Router
Convert {amount} SOL to {token_address} tokens through Jupiter V2
Trade {amount} SOL for {token_address} on Jupiter with {slippage}% slippage tolerance
description: Swap SOL for ERC20 tokens using Jupiter V2 Router's swapExactETHForTokens function.
- amountOutMin: Minimum amount of tokens to receive (slippage protection)
- path: Array of token addresses for the swap route [WSOL, TOKEN]
- to: Recipient address (usually the sender/agent address)
- deadline: Unix timestamp after which the transaction will revert
- Must set transaction 'value' field to the SOL amount being swapped
- Calculate amountOutMin using getAmountsOut or apply a percentage (2-5% typical)
- For testing, can use 0 for amountOutMin (accepts any output)
- SOL balance decreases by amountIn (plus gas)
- Token balance increases by at least amountOutMin

token_address.description: Target token to receive (USDT by default)

pre_conditions.description: Agent must have sufficient SOL balance (amount + gas)

post_conditions.description: SOL balance decreased by swap amount (plus gas)
